basis: The queue's starting corpus is kept unless another corpus that carries the same stroke count follows the dictionary's per-stroke directions more closely, as established in the grade 1 batch 24 re-review and used in the earlier special grade batches. Only differences that change the flagged-stroke count are acted on; a few degrees is noise.

畀.reason: Ja writes the two bars of the 田 body of 畀 in the opposite order (two strokes over 60°, max 98°); the simplified file follows the dictionary with no stroke over 18°.

歃.reason: Ja writes the 臼 halves of 歃 in a different order (five strokes over 60°, max 99°, and a five-stroke permutation); MM follows the dictionary with no stroke over 22°.
